body:
WSP weight experiments need reproducible links between stored weights, runtime activations, numerical proposals and official outcomes. This PR adds inspection/edit/verification tools and bounded experiment owners, with exact parent provenance, lossless trial retention and explicit CPU/GPU validation limits. Official scorers, manifest selections and default inference behavior remain unchanged.

## Tools

- CPU checkpoint statistics, sampled spectra/alignment, dtype-aware differences, scalar/vector/sparse-matrix/full-unit edits, shard reuse and complete saved-byte verification.
- Runtime activation capture with question/call/rank/token-position joins, dropped/unmatched/writer-state accounting, comparison and HTML inspection.
- Gemma sensitivity, coupled-objective proposals and fixed finite replay with BF16 readback and exact restoration. Proxies never become WSP scores; sampled norms and full-model denominators remain distinct.
- Explicit service owners that preserve unrelated services and restore exact owned containers, plus a host-wrapper option to reuse a full local Docker image ID without rebuilding or pulling. Mounted runtime caches and serving conditions still require separate attestation.

- Native public-answer generation with retained HTTP failures, plus isolated offline scientific/helper diagnostics that bind complete response envelopes and preserve missing/error outcomes.

[Tool inventory and guides](https://github.com/ytworks/kairyu-bench/blob/codex/weight-observation-tools/docs/wsp-tool-inventory.md) contain the executable entry points and validation boundaries.

## Current experiment evidence

The current study independently re-audited 151 historical runs without inheriting earlier hypotheses, rankings or adoption decisions. Canonical full WSP and earlier code-only screens are separate cohorts; a code-only 90-item screen is not a complete tier30 evaluation. AV is tied for the highest completed comparable canonical dev10 code score and preserves the accumulated saved edits. It is the current study's parent; historical AD/AV/BA decisions remain historical records.

A fresh observed AV run completed **all 778 questions / 14 areas**, with no unscored items or API failures:

| Metric | AV |
|---|---:|
| Official code source mean | 87.777778 |
| HumanEval+ | 10/10 |
| LiveCodeBench | 5/6 |
| MBPP+ | 8/10 |
| Overall 14-area mean | 77.208631 |
| Terminal-Bench | 1/2; 19 agent steps / 39 tool calls |
| WSP wall time (includes loading) / data loading | 1800.7 / 102.8 seconds |

The code failures are `arc191_c`, `Mbpp/410`, and `Mbpp/576`. The scorer/contract audit explains their limits without changing their official zeroes. Every official item has joined activations. The capture still reports `partial_or_running`: 5,760 records from two pre-run requests are unmatched, despite closed writers and zero dropped/error/quota-loss records. Exact code-call/rank/offset/accepted-state evidence and all 14-area outcomes are retained.

Two fixed new joint-matrix proposals were measured on all 120 authored cases in parent → candidate → restored-parent order:

| Candidate | Changed BF16 cells / matrices | Finite design constraints | Original advance gate | Official candidate score |
|---|---:|---:|---|---|
| F01 | 201,426 / 410 | 66/76 met | Failed: referent retention | Unmeasured |
| F02 | 203,419 / 410 | 64/76 met | Failed: referent signs and workflow retention | 87.777778; no advancement |

Both have exact selected-word proof and zero restoration drift. These are teacher-forced proxy measurements, not coding successes. F01 was saved and fully verified; its complete weights are now losslessly represented by the fixed AV parent, archived exact edits/metadata and full hashes, freeing only this session's duplicated payload. No failed trial was dropped.

Actual **Claude Opus 5.5** reviewed both proposals; prompt hashes and response-model receipts are retained. After F02 failed its proxy gate, a separately labeled **post-data amendment** was frozen before materialization or official F02 measurement. It permits one full, matched 778-question diagnostic without further solving, preserves the failed gate, and fixes official tradeoff and repeat/selection rules. F02 materialization and complete saved-byte verification passed (215.174 / 174.631 seconds). Its official run then completed all 778 items, zero unscored/errors/retries. Code is **87.777778, tied with AV**, with all 26 item scores unchanged and the same three failures. Overall is 77.865851 (+0.657220 points): instructions +10 and long-context +6.25 coexist with vision -6.25, tools -5, math -3.125 and reasoning -2.173913. The frozen strict-code-gain rule therefore rejects advancement; AV remains the editing parent and the conditional confirmation pair is not triggered. [Every item/source/area and usage is retained](https://github.com/ytworks/kairyu-bench/blob/codex/weight-observation-tools/docs/experiments/2026-11-07-f02-official-results.md). The first deployment and automatic rollback failed because a stopped retired observer shared Compose labels. The original AV was recovered with its exact CID, other production services and all benchmark/capture host artifacts were preserved, and a CLI regression fix now rejects ambiguous membership and disables orphan removal. The failed attempt, recovery, missing retired-container stdout limitation and successful retry remain in the [deployment record](https://github.com/ytworks/kairyu-bench/blob/codex/weight-observation-tools/docs/experiments/2026-11-07-f02-serving-preview.md).

- [Fresh purpose-led study and all decisions](https://github.com/ytworks/kairyu-bench/blob/codex/weight-observation-tools/docs/experiments/2026-11-07-fresh-purpose-weight-editing.md)
- [Independent historical audit](https://github.com/ytworks/kairyu-bench/blob/codex/weight-observation-tools/docs/experiments/2026-11-07-fresh-evidence-audit.md)
- [Complete AV measurement and capture limits](https://github.com/ytworks/kairyu-bench/blob/codex/weight-observation-tools/docs/experiments/2026-11-07-fresh-av-live-observation.md)
- [Frozen F02 amendment and review disposition](https://github.com/ytworks/kairyu-bench/blob/codex/weight-observation-tools/docs/experiments/2026-11-07-f02-transfer-amendment.md)

The F02 ordinary container was restored with its exact ID. Both activation writers retain `closed=false` after an engine abort/force-kill shutdown. Gzip EOF and record totals match saved status, drops/errors are zero and all 778 items have observations, but missing close acknowledgments and two unmatched pre-run requests remain explicit capture limitations.

An independent [audit of all 120 authored proxy cases](https://github.com/ytworks/kairyu-bench/blob/codex/weight-observation-tools/docs/experiments/2026-11-07-authored-case-audit.md) found 11 concrete contract/precondition counterexamples. F02’s largest valid one-token primitive contributes 74.38% of positive case-margin deltas; no correct/foil pair ranking flips. These teacher-forced measurements are not free-generation accuracy. Inputs, failed gates, audit fixture failure and both successful audit revisions remain unchanged and inspectable.

Cumulative AV has completed [canonical dev30](https://github.com/ytworks/kairyu-bench/blob/codex/weight-observation-tools/docs/experiments/2026-11-07-av-dev30-dp4-run.md): **2,338/2,338 scored, zero unscored/API errors/retries; code official four-source mean 72.936508, overall 76.720059**. Code source scores are HumanEval+ 96.666667 (29/30), LiveCodeBench 75 (15/20), MBPP+ 76.666667 (23/30), SciCode 43.412698 (2 fully solved, 4 partial, 4 zero; all 10 scored). Terminal-Bench is 5/6 and SWE-bench Pro 1/4. Loading-inclusive wall time is 2,018.9 seconds, including 111.2 seconds loading. Independent full-report reconstruction agrees. This differs from tier10 in sources and topology and is not a direct score regression comparison.

The user-approved four-container AV switch preserved all 23 unrelated containers and reconciled the global served-model record. Conditions were four ordinary TP2 replicas, MTP4, 256/32/4 concurrency and client HTTP tracing only. The owner exited normally and released its lock; all four ordinary AV replicas remain healthy and idle. F02 remains unadopted. The 90-point goal has not been reached.

The separate [authored native-generation diagnostic](https://github.com/ytworks/kairyu-bench/blob/codex/weight-observation-tools/docs/experiments/2026-11-07-av-authored120-native-generation.md) preserves **241 POST attempts**: v1 returned HTTP 400 for all 120 cases (zero public answers), one separately authorized transport smoke succeeded, and v2 produced all 120 public answers with no API/empty/length failures in **133.137 seconds**. The compatible server-default thinking protocol and HTTP failure receipts are documented; no hidden reasoning is saved. These are known calibration inputs, not unseen evaluation.

| Separate CPU diagnostic | Pass / fail / unknown | Fixture trials passed | Seconds |
|---|---:|---:|---:|
| [All 48 existing catalog cases](https://github.com/ytworks/kairyu-bench/blob/codex/weight-observation-tools/docs/experiments/2026-11-07-authored48-execution-results.md) | 46 / 2 / 0 | 375/384 | 49.884 |
| [Additional all 16 fixed helper stages](https://github.com/ytworks/kairyu-bench/blob/codex/weight-observation-tools/docs/experiments/2026-11-07-av-helper16-offline-results.md) | 16 / 0 / 0 | 128/128 | 15.449 |

The catalog failures are `science-batched-linear-system` and `science-library-symbolic-numeric-variable-order`. Both diagnostics preserve their three-case contract-caveat strata and every raw outcome. The new offline adapter retains the complete 72 response identity, scores all 16 fixed stages, and marks 56 not targeted; supplied helpers stay fixed and expected values stay outside the isolated worker. These results are **not combined into a 120-case capability rate or official WSP score**. Source snapshots, the failed transport trial, corrected test assertion, all generation attempts and unchanged-service/cleanup receipts remain inspectable.

The [complete saved-weight diff](https://github.com/ytworks/kairyu-bench/blob/codex/weight-observation-tools/docs/experiments/2026-11-07-av-f02-weight-activation-comparison-prep.md) independently compared all 1,188 stored tensors and 31,273,088,876 elements. The exact 203,419 changed BF16 cells give delta L2 1.108946: relative to all checkpoint entries this is 0.0000113413, while relative to the 410 complete edited matrices it is 0.000418248. Changed-coordinate-only and sampled-support ratios remain separately labeled. A [four-task offline viewer](https://github.com/ytworks/kairyu-bench/blob/codex/weight-observation-tools/docs/experiments/2026-11-07-av-f02-four-code-observation.md) preserves separate call/rank/position/accepted scopes; missing pair metadata blocks strict numeric activation deltas. It does not establish causal skill localization.

F02 now also has a verified lossless dependent archive with all exact edits, metadata, provenance and reconstruction instructions. Its complete payload remains present; no further disk release has occurred.

Historical experiments, partials, failed setups, proxy losses and repeated runs remain in the experiment documents and numeric evidence. Selected gains are not summed into a causal cumulative gain. No code score above 90, general coding improvement, final candidate confirmation across tiers/test, final edited DeepSWE run or Hugging Face publication is claimed yet. The completed AV tier30 baseline does not fulfill those remaining requirements.

The final edited-model DeepSWE pass with **32 workers and all 113 questions**, its wiki result append, and conditional Hugging Face registration have not been performed in this study.

## Validation

- Latest [CPU r6](https://github.com/ytworks/kairyu-bench/blob/codex/weight-observation-tools/docs/experiments/2026-11-07-cpu-validation-r6.md): **532 collected = 475 passed + 57 skips**, 47.444 seconds (47.963 wall); Ruff, mypy (74 source files), data consistency and 31 shell checks passed. Six source/test hashes were unchanged. Separate scientific-CPU focused 10 tests also passed; CPU checks are not GPU/capability validation.
- Earlier CPU suite: **522 collected = 466 passed + 56 optional-dependency skips**, 45.446 seconds after the real Compose-failure fix. Ruff, mypy (74 source files), data consistency and syntax of 31 shell files passed.
- The first suite attempt failed because of an overlong temporary socket path and missing CPU-venv `PATH`; the failures and corrected execution are retained. A separate short-directory setup attempt was denied before tests ran.
- After independent review added `--pull=never`, all four wrapper tests, Ruff and shell syntax passed again. These check exact image reuse and rejection of mutable, missing or mismatched images.
- F01/F02 real finite replay and exact service restoration completed. F02 saved verification, ordinary serving deployment and complete official WSP scoring passed; the candidate has no code gain and is not advanced. Capture closure limitations remain separate. CPU success is not reported as GPU or capability validation.
- Commits `cceb2f20604afca3c8a811885fedaf29c7bf085f` and `b3806da2f721a02ed0d7163f7fb3e37f989e00b1` passed all four GitHub checks: CPU tests, DeepSWE runtime, Terminal-Bench runtime and Docker. Later evidence/tool records receive their own CI status.
